description: #531 parity: 1D nonlinear diffusion d_x(f*d_x(u)) with smooth periodic fields on uniform grid. Conditions derived from MOL #531 NonLinear_Diffusion Test 00 at pinned SHA.

tolerance.notes: Nonlinear Laplacian coefficients are rationals in dx and field values; should be bit-identical across bindings to this tolerance.

fixtures.name: nonlinear_diffusion_periodic
fixtures.notes: 80-cell uniform grid on [0,2] with periodic BCs. Two smooth positive fields: u(x)=2.0+sin(pi*x) (solution) and f(x)=1/(2.0+sin(pi*x)) (diffusivity, reciprocal of u mimicking u^{-1} from MOL #531 nonlinear diffusion). Both fields are strictly positive on [1/3,1] and [1,3] respectively.

f.notes: Reciprocal of u, mimicking u^{-1} diffusivity from MOL #531 nonlinear diffusion test.
